messages.text: Does the Section 31 20 00 required compaction density for the structural fill under the building pad shown on Civil Detail 2/C501 hold up against the geotechnical report's requirements for this area? This is becoming more pressing as backfill work approaches. We don't anticipate any effect on the contract sum. This isn't holding up any current earthwork activity. Please respond within five days so we can schedule the civil inspection.
The geotechnical report already covers this -- see Detail 6/C-601 for the Section 31 20 00 required compaction density for the structural fill under the building pad. No further action needed.
